package unformatted

// gofmt strips the parentheses around an if's condition, which the pattern looks through, so both report these.
func guards(m map[string]int, k string) {
	if _, ok := m[k]; (ok) {
		m[k]++
	} else {
		m[k] = 1
	}
	if _, ok := m[k]; ((ok)) {
		m[k] += 2
	} else {
		m[k] = 2
	}
	if _, ok := m[k]; (!ok) {
		m[k]++
	} else {
		m[k] = 1
	}
	if _, ok := ((m[k])); (ok) {
		((m[k]))++
	} else {
		m[k] = ((1))
	}
}
